podcast.body: A former number one hit, this song was positioned just a couple of notches below "Bad Girls" on the charts, contributing to Donna Summer having two of the top three singles in America simultaneously. "While the former number one hot stuff was just a couple of notches below, Donna Summer had two of the top three singles in America."

podcast.body: This song was one of Donna Summer's back-to-back number one hits in June and July of 1979. Both this track and its follow-up, "Bad Girls," were included in Billboard's top five tally for that year's Song of the Summer. "The first of those hits was even called hot stuff."
